summary: Phase 2 testing complete. All 3 test cases pass: config validation rejects empty URLs (TEST-P2-001), config validation rejects non-HTTP URLs (TEST-P2-002), and the full regression suite passes with 26/26 tests (TEST-P2-003). The Phase 2 implementation (URL validation, CLI error handling, print-to-logger migration, module-level Jinja2 env, trust boundary comments, cache wiring, and orchestrator test updates) is verified correct with no bugs found.

patternsFollowed.notes: Config validation tests use plain assert via pytest.raises
Dry-run and cap-message tests use caplog.at_level with logger='courier.orchestrator' — verified both pass

patternsFollowed.patternName: Mocking pipeline modules in orchestrator tests
patternsFollowed.notes: All tests mocking store include mock_store.read_cached_html.return_value = None for cache wiring compatibility

testCases.description: Run all tests to confirm Phase 2 changes (print-to-logger, cache wiring, config validation, caplog migration) do not break existing functionality
testCases.notes: 26/26 tests pass across test_smoke.py (3), test_orchestrator.py (18), test_fetcher.py (3), test_main.py (2). The two previously-capsys tests (dry_run and cap_message) now assert on caplog.text successfully. All orchestrator tests with mock_store have read_cached_html.return_value = None.

nextSteps: Phase 3: Test Infrastructure & New Test Modules — add conftest.py with shared fixtures, write test_extractor.py, test_store.py, and test_compiler.py
additionalNotes: All Phase 2 acceptance criteria verified: load_config() validates URLs, __main__.py catches config exceptions, all print() calls replaced with logger.info(), capsys tests migrated to caplog, module-level _env/_template in compiler.py, trust boundary comments in compiler.py and document.xhtml, cache wiring in _process_article() via _fetch_raw_html() helper, and all mock_store tests set read_cached_html.return_value = None.
